question: 按 customer_unique_id 去重，全量复购率是多少
gold_sql: WITH cust_orders AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN n_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) FROM cust_orders

question: 全量各支付方式的金额占比
gold_sql: WITH pay_types AS (SELECT p.order_id, p.payment_type, SUM(p.payment_value) AS amount FROM order_payments p GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT pay.payment_type, SUM(pay.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(pay.amount)) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM orders o JOIN pay_types pay ON pay.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: 2018 年 1 月到 6 月的 GMV 环比变化
gold_sql: WITH base AS (SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1), lagged AS (SELECT month, v, LAG(v) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_v FROM base) SELECT month, v AS gmv, prev_v, CASE WHEN prev_v IS NULL OR prev_v = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (v - prev_v) / prev_v END AS mom FROM lagged ORDER BY month
